Description: INFS3701 Corporate Gateway: private two-AZ Flask, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL, private S3, HTTPS ALB, CloudWatch and SNS email. Run tools/prepare_lab.py for a ready-to-upload template. Reuses existing lab IAM only; no domain required for disclosed self-signed lab HTTPS.

Label.default: Email and HTTPS certificate (pre-filled when prepared with tools/prepare_lab.py)
Existing Learner Lab access and optional custom domain

ExistingInstanceProfile.Description: Existing EC2 instance profile; no IAM resources will be created.

ExistingRoleArn.Description: Usually leave blank for the existing /LabRole in this account. This assumes the standard lab role exists; it does not create one. prepare_lab.py verifies the profile and fills its actual role ARN, including any path.

CertificateArn.Description: HTTPS requires a certificate. Run tools/prepare_lab.py to pre-fill a temporary self-signed lab certificate without a domain, or supply an existing matching issued ACM certificate. Self-signed certificates cause browser warnings.

ApplicationHostname.Description: LEAVE BLANK if you have no domain. The output uses the AWS load-balancer address. With a self-signed lab certificate, expect a trust/name warning. No domain purchase is required for that lab-only route.

AlertEmail.Description: Email for SNS alerts. You must click Confirm subscription in its email.

AdminUsername.Description: Portal username. The generated login password is in ApplicationSecretArn.

ZoneA.Description: First zone; choose a zone supporting t3 instances.

ZoneB.Description: Second, different zone; choose one supporting t3 instances.

InstanceType.Description: One instance of this size is created in each zone.

DBInstanceClass.Description: Small PostgreSQL 16 class, subject to lab permissions and regional support.

DBEngineVersion.Description: PostgreSQL major 16 (AWS selects the default minor), or an available 16.x version confirmed by preflight. Engine availability changes.

LogRetentionDays.Description: Keep application logs for this many days. One day reduces retained lab logs; export evidence before it expires.

Properties.GroupDescription: Private app: HTTPS from ALB only. Outbound DNS, HTTPS, package HTTP, and database TLS.

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: AWS APIs, TLS and dependency downloads

Properties.GroupDescription: Public HTTPS entry and HTTP redirect; targets only on HTTPS.

Properties.Description: Only the ALB can reach application HTTPS

Properties.GroupDescription: PostgreSQL only from the gateway app tier.

Properties.Description: Generated credentials for restricted gateway PostgreSQL application user.
Portal login. View this secret after deployment to retrieve the generated password.

Properties.DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private data subnets in two different Availability Zones.

Properties.Description: Gateway PostgreSQL 16 requires encrypted client connections.

#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
dnf install -y aws-cfn-bootstrap
signal_reason() {
  stage=$(cat /var/log/gateway-setup-stage 2>/dev/null || echo bootstrap)
  err=$(tr '\n' ' ' </var/log/gateway-setup-error 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-120 || true)
  if test -n "$err"; then printf 'Setup exit %s; stage: %s; error: %s' "$1" "$stage" "$err"
  else printf 'Setup exit %s; stage: %s' "$1" "$stage"; fi
}
trap 'rc=$?; /opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal -e "$rc" --reason "$(signal_reason "$rc")" --stack "${AWS::StackName}" --resource "AppServerA" --region "${AWS::Region}" || true' EXIT
install -d -m 750 /etc/gateway
mkdir -p /opt/gateway/src
/opt/aws/bin/cfn-init -v --stack "${AWS::StackName}" --resource "AppServerA" --region "${AWS::Region}"
cat > /etc/gateway/runtime.json <<'GATEWAY_CONFIG'
{
  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
  "db_host": "${GatewayDatabase.Endpoint.Address}",
  "db_name": "gateway",
  "db_master_secret": "${MasterSecretArn}",
  "db_app_secret": "${DatabaseAppSecret}",
  "app_secret": "${ApplicationSecret}",
  "bucket": "${FilesBucket}",
  "alb_arn": "${GatewayALB}",
  "target_group_name": "${TargetGroupName}",
  "dashboard_name": "${AWS::StackName}-health",
  "topic_arn": "${AlertTopic}",
  "stack_name": "${AWS::StackName}",
  "instance_name": "app-a",
  "zone": "${ZoneA}",
  "alarm_name": "${AWS::StackName}-healthy-targets",
  "log_group": "${AppLogs}",
  "certificate_ca": "/opt/gateway/rds-ca.pem"
}
GATEWAY_CONFIG
python3 -c "import base64,lzma,io,tarfile; data=lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(open('/opt/gateway/bundle.b64').read())); tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)).extractall('/opt/gateway/src')"

ApplicationURL.Description: Portal URL. A supplied hostname needs DNS pointing to the ALB. ALB DNS URL may not match your certificate.

LoadBalancerDNS.Description: DNS target for your validated application hostname.

ExistingRoleUsed.Description: Existing role named in the bucket policy. It must match the role in ExistingInstanceProfile. The template creates no IAM role.

CloudWatchDashboardURL.Description: Dashboard with ALB, EC2, RDS and alarms.

AppServerA.Description: Private app instance ID. Use EC2 Connect > Session Manager.

AppServerB.Description: Private app instance ID. Use EC2 Connect > Session Manager.

BucketName.Description: Retained after stack deletion. Empty ALL object versions/delete markers, then delete the bucket manually after evidence is saved.

DatabaseIdentifier.Description: Lab database. Stack deletion permanently deletes it without a final snapshot.

DatabaseEndpoint.Description: Private PostgreSQL endpoint; connections must verify TLS.

ApplicationSecretArn.Description: View this secret in Secrets Manager to retrieve the portal username/password. Never put the password in screenshots.

DatabaseAppSecretArn.Description: Generated restricted PostgreSQL app-user credentials; not the portal password.

AlertTopicArn.Description: SNS email topic. Confirm the emailed subscription before running alarm tests.

HealthyTargetsAlarmName.Description: Main availability alarm: minimum healthy hosts <2 for two minutes.

TargetGroupArn.Description: ALB target group for target-health evidence.

LogGroupName.Description: Application, Nginx and bootstrap logs if permitted by the existing LabRole.
